changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetHash_backup') BEGIN DROP TABLE integration.AssetHash_backup; END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetHash_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [integration].[AssetHash_backup]( [SynchedAssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Section] [smallint] NOT NULL, [RequestNumber] [int] NULL, [SourceID] [varchar](100) NOT NULL, [Hash] [varchar](50) NULL, [Action] [varchar](1) NULL, [UpdateHash] [varchar](50) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntegrationAssetHash] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [SynchedAssetTypeID] ASC, [Section] ASC, [SourceID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IntegrationAssetHash_RequestInfo') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IntegrationAssetHash_RequestInfo] ON [integration].[AssetHash_backup] ( [SynchedAssetTypeID] ASC, [Section] ASC, [RequestNumber] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IntegrationAssetHash_RequestInfo_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IntegrationAssetHash_RequestInfo_Include] ON [integration].[AssetHash_backup] ( [RequestNumber] ASC, [Section] ASC, [SynchedAssetTypeID] ASC, [Action] ASC ) INCLUDE([Hash]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IntegrationAssetHash_SynchedAssetType_Section_Action_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IntegrationAssetHash_SynchedAssetType_Section_Action_Include] ON [integration].[AssetHash_backup] ( [SynchedAssetTypeID] ASC, [Section] ASC, [Action] ASC ) INCLUDE([RequestNumber]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IntegrationAssetHash_SynchedAssetType_SourceID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IntegrationAssetHash_SynchedAssetType_SourceID] ON [integration].[AssetHash_backup] ( [SynchedAssetTypeID] ASC, [SourceID] ASC ) END
